## Where I am

The SRE take-home exercise now lives in its own private repo, `kestrel-analytics/sre-take-home`. It has a Docker Compose setup that builds `flaky-svc` from source, a broken alert rule, a connection leak, an over-broad IAM policy in Terraform, a 3-hour time box, and a rubric with four areas scored 0–3 and no cut-off. The `hiring/` folder is removed from the infra branch, but that removal is not committed, and no PR was opened. Nothing has been sent to the candidate.

- [en-cours] Removing `hiring/` from `maya/sre-take-home` is an uncommitted working-tree change. The branch will be dropped later.
- [prochaine-étape] After the candidate call on Thursday at 4pm Tel Aviv time, Maya sends the exercise herself.
- [essai-raté] `docker compose up` failed with `exec format error` because the prebuilt `flaky-svc:0.3` image was amd64-only. A multi-arch `buildx --load` also failed: the docker exporter cannot export manifest lists. The fix was to build `flaky-svc` from source in compose.
- [décision] No k8s and no optional part; 3-hour limit; Terraform and compose only (source: t03)
- [décision] Candidates build `flaky-svc` from source; no prebuilt image is published (source: t06)
- [décision] No threshold on scores; they are input for the panel, with Noa as second reviewer (source: t10)
- [décision] The exercise goes in its own private repo, not in infra (source: t12)
- [décision] Delete `hiring/` from the infra branch, with no PR in infra (source: t14)
- [décision] Nobody is emailed by Leon; Maya sends the exercise herself after the call (source: t16)
